content: The European Commission's GDPR explainer lists transparency, access, erasure, portability, and rights concerning automated decision-making/profiling as individual rights; applicability to Jobot depends on launch geography and processing context. W3C WCAG 2.2 includes success criteria for accessible authentication, consistent help, and status messages. Official OpenAI API data controls document endpoint-specific logging, retention, and regional-processing distinctions, so a hosted product cannot safely summarize AI privacy as a generic no-retention guarantee; disclose the selected provider and actual processing terms.
